messages.content: User task: Help me draft a short apology email to a colleague.

raw_response:
Subject: Apology for My Oversight

Hi [Colleague's Name],

I’m sorry for [briefly describe what happened]. It was inconsiderate and I understand it caused inconvenience. I value our collaboration and will ensure it doesn’t happen again. Please let me know if there’s anything I can do to make things right.

Thank you for your understanding.

Best,
[Your Name]

PLAN: Identify the specific issue to apologize for.
PLAN: Draft a concise, sincere apology email.
PLAN: Review tone and send to colleague.
